cta_sentence: If you want a foolproof first recipe plus every wax, wick and fragrance pairing that actually works, my e-book The $3 Luxury Candle walks you through it all:
body: About to buy your first candle-making kit? Watch this first. Most beginner kits are built to look complete in a photo, not to actually teach you to make a good candle — and they set you up to fail and quietly give up. In this video I show you what's actually worth buying, what's filler, the one cheap tool that decides whether your first candle even works, and a dead-simple first recipe that comes out beautifully on your very first try.
more: Candice has been making small-batch soy candles for over a decade. Every week I walk through real candle making one honest step at a time — no fluff, no expensive gear, just what actually works. Subscribe and tell me in the comments what made you want to start making candles.
